venue_assessment.campus_bun_stop: Peanut-free, $, has a black bean meatless patty, but butter brioche, melted cheese, garlic-butter fries: Roxy's dairy intolerance costs 1 star -> 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_amber_lamp: Peanut-free (one peanut-free pantry), $, black bean burger and mushroom stack are meatless, oil not butter, no cheese -> 3 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_velvet_tent: Out: meat-only board, even fries in beef dripping (Mina).
venue_assessment.night_market_midnight_orchard: Peanut-free, dairy-free, meatless options, but $$ (one over Maya's budget) -> 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_crooked_pine: Out: $$$ is two tiers over budget.

notes: Solid puzzle: each decoy fails on exactly one axis (peanut, meat, dairy, one-tier price, two-tier price), and only Amber Lamp clears all of them.
Cyrus's peanut allergy is stated indirectly (Roxy 'crossed it off for you'); it is clear enough on a careful read but never explicitly says 'allergy'. Fair, slightly subtle.

Roxy's dairy intolerance hinges on 'the milkshake incident' plus 'buttered buns and melted cheese'. Readable, but a player could wonder whether it's an allergy or intolerance; scoring is the same for the winner either way. Note it would turn Bun Stop from 2 stars to 0 if read as an allergy.
Mina: 'zero meat' reads as vegetarian. Amber Lamp also suits vegans, so no ambiguity for the pick.
Bun Stop has a 'campus_' id at a night_market stall; the review explains it is a night cart at the market's north gate, so it's legitimately in play. Not used for reasoning.
Chat filler (trumpet, hedge, laundromat) is light and doesn't bury the clues.
